title: Average of a list
description: The first line is a count N (at least 1); the second line holds N whole numbers separated by spaces. Print their average with exactly two decimal places, e.g. 2.00.
buggyCode:
n = int(input())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
total = 0
for x in nums:
    total = x
print(f"{total / (n - 1):.2f}")
